name: ActionMenu
description: `ActionMenu` is a composable Base UI menu with button and low-level trigger options.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the button to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown in a trailing counter, for a button that acts on a known quantity.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents activation and removes the button from the keyboard order.

props.name: inactive
props.description: Marks the button temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable, so its reason can be announced.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line instead of being clipped.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Icon shown before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the button is loading.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the button.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Icon shown at the far end, conventionally a chevron for a button that opens something.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight of the button. Use `primary` for the main action and `danger` for a destructive one.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the content along the anchor's edge.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift in pixels along the anchor's edge, or a callback that computes it from the measured sizes.

props.name: positionerClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the element that positions the content.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the anchor the content opens on.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels between the content and its anchor, or a callback that computes it.

props.name: inactiveText

props.name: selected

props.name: variant

props.name: truncate
props.description: Clips the description to one line instead of wrapping.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the description sits beside the label or on its own line.
